clip_key: # Own lines for the qbe, mk2drone, mpo and mtm probe cores (characters from their in-game part descriptions). New keys: pk_
# QBE: tiny, no reaction wheels, 5 EC, built for optional return. Drone Core: C7's AI that replaced the test pilots.
# MPO: the Moho Planetary Observer, loves heat, huge antenna. MTM: the patient xenon workhorse that carries it.
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

spanish: Hola, QBE. ¿Cuánta batería te queda?
english: Hi, QBE. How much battery do you have left? | Hi, QBE. How much battery do you have left? | Hello, QBE. Battery check?
[beeps very faintly]

spanish: Vale. No hables mucho.
english: Okay. Don't talk too much. | Okay. Don't talk too much. | Okay. Save your words.

spanish: ¿Ya sabes girar, cubito?
english: Can you turn yet, little cube? | Can you turn yet, little cube? | Little cube, can you turn yet?
[beeps indignantly]

spanish: Ya. Sin ruedas de reacción. Lo sé.
english: Right. No reaction wheels. I know. | Right. No reaction wheels. I know. | Oh, right. No reaction wheels.

spanish: Eres la sonda más ligera del programa.
english: You're the lightest probe in the program. | You're the lightest probe in the program. | No probe in the program is lighter than you.
[beeps proudly]

spanish: Los ingenieros dicen que eres perfecto para misiones de regreso opcional.
english: The engineers say you're perfect for optional return missions. | The engineers say you're perfect for optional return missions. | Engineering says you're great for optional return missions.
[beeps uncertainly]

spanish: No, no es nada malo. Creo.
english: No, it's nothing bad. I think. | No, it's nothing bad. I think. | Not bad. Probably.

spanish: Cubito, cabes en mi bolsillo.
english: Little cube, you'd fit in my pocket. | Little cube, you'd fit in my pocket. | You'd fit in my pocket, little cube.
[beeps cheerfully]

spanish: ¿Te sientes pequeño ahí arriba?
english: Feeling small up there? | Feeling small up there? | Do you feel small up there?
[beeps defiantly]

spanish: Pequeño pero valiente.
english: Small but brave. | Small but brave. | Small. But brave.

spanish: QBE, ¿qué tal la vista?
english: QBE, how's the view? | QBE, how's the view? | QBE, nice view?
[beeps excitedly]

spanish: ¿Has visto algo interesante?
english: Seen anything interesting? | Seen anything interesting? | Anything interesting out there?
[beeps at everything]

spanish: Todo te parece grande, ¿verdad?
english: Everything looks big to you, right? | Everything looks big to you, right? | It all looks huge to you, doesn't it?

spanish: QBE, cinco unidades de carga no dan para mucho.
english: QBE, five units of charge don't go very far. | QBE, five units of charge don't go very far. | Five units of charge, QBE. That's not much.
[beeps drowsily]

spanish: ¿Otra vez sin batería, cubito?
english: Out of battery again, little cube? | Out of battery again, little cube? | Battery empty again, little cube?
[beeps very sleepily]
[beeps a tiny hello]

spanish: Hola, cubito. Te oímos.
english: Hi, little cube. We hear you. | Hi, little cube. We hear you. | Hello, little cube. We hear you.
[beeps hopefully]

spanish: Sí, QBE, alguien vendrá a buscarte. Algún día.
english: Yes, QBE, someone will come get you. Someday. | Yes, QBE, someone will come get you. Someday. | Yes, QBE. Someone will pick you up. One day.
[beeps worriedly]
[beeps very loudly]

spanish: Mucho ruido para alguien tan pequeño.
english: A lot of noise for someone so small. | A lot of noise for someone so small. | So much noise from such a small cube.
[beeps slowly]

spanish: ¿Aburrido? Eres un cubo. No puedes ni girar.
english: Bored? You're a cube. You can't even turn. | Bored? You're a cube. You can't even turn. | Bored? You can't even turn, cube.
[beeps indignantly]
[beeps in circles]

spanish: QBE, no tienes ruedas de reacción. Solo aguanta.
english: QBE, you have no reaction wheels. Just hang on. | QBE, you have no reaction wheels. Just hang on. | No reaction wheels, QBE. Just hold on.

spanish: Aguanta, cubito. Pesas setenta kilos, puedes con esto.
english: Hang on, little cube. You weigh seventy kilos, you can take it. | Hang on, little cube. You weigh seventy kilos, you can take it. | Hold on, little cube. Seventy kilos can take this.
[beeps bravely]

spanish: Un día entero, QBE. Con esa batería, es un milagro.
english: A whole day, QBE. With that battery, it's a miracle. | A whole day, QBE. With that battery, it's a miracle. | One full day, QBE. A miracle with that battery.
[beeps very proudly]
[beeps very proudly]

spanish: En órbita, cubito. Nada mal para una caja.
english: In orbit, little cube. Not bad for a box. | In orbit, little cube. Not bad for a box. | Orbit, little cube. Good for a box.

spanish: ¡Datos del QBE! Pequeños, pero datos.
english: Data from the QBE! Small, but data. | Data from the QBE! Small, but data. | QBE data! Tiny, but data.
[beeps proudly]
[beeps delightedly]

spanish: Sí, QBE, lo tenemos. Descansa un poco.
english: Yes, QBE, we got it. Rest a bit. | Yes, QBE, we got it. Rest a bit. | Got it, QBE. Take a rest.
[beeps faintly]

spanish: Ya lo sabemos, cubito. Cinco unidades. Duerme.
english: We know, little cube. Five units. Sleep. | We know, little cube. Five units. Sleep. | We know. Five units. Go to sleep, little cube.
[beeps eagerly]

spanish: ¡Buenos días, cubito!
english: Good morning, little cube! | Good morning, little cube! | Morning, little cube!

spanish: QBE, esto es {body}. Es un poco más grande que tú.
english: QBE, this is {body}. It's a bit bigger than you.
[beeps excitedly]
[beeps in alarm]

spanish: Tranquilo, QBE. Esa pieza costaba más que tú.
english: Easy, QBE. That part cost more than you. | Easy, QBE. That part cost more than you. | Calm, QBE. That part was pricier than you.
[beeps indignantly]
[beeps very eagerly]

spanish: ¡Ahí estás, cubito! Creíamos que te habíamos perdido.
english: There you are, little cube! We thought we'd lost you. | There you are, little cube! We thought we'd lost you. | Little cube! We thought you were gone.
[beeps bouncily]

spanish: ¿Un aterrizaje? Eso no estaba en el plan, QBE.
english: A landing? That wasn't in the plan, QBE. | A landing? That wasn't in the plan, QBE. | Landed? Not in the plan, QBE.
[beeps a farewell]

spanish: Ahora estás solo, cubito. Como siempre.
english: You're on your own now, little cube. As always. | You're on your own now, little cube. As always. | All alone now, little cube. Like always.
[beeps very bravely]

spanish: Agárrate, cubito. Pesas casi nada.
english: Hold on, little cube. You weigh almost nothing. | Hold on, little cube. You weigh almost nothing. | Hang on, little cube. You're so light.

spanish: QBE, tenemos un plan de maniobra. Sin girar. Ya veremos.
english: QBE, we have a burn plan. Without turning. We'll see. | QBE, we have a burn plan. Without turning. We'll see. | QBE, burn plan ready. No turning. Good luck.
[beeps doubtfully]
[beeps a tiny stream]

spanish: Recibido, QBE. Pocos datos, mucho entusiasmo.
english: Copy, QBE. Little data, lots of enthusiasm. | Copy, QBE. Little data, lots of enthusiasm. | Copy, QBE. Not much data. Lots of spirit.
[beeps at the port]

spanish: ¿Te han recogido, QBE? Así que el regreso sí era una opción.
english: Someone picked you up, QBE? So return was an option after all. | Someone picked you up, QBE? So return was an option after all. | Picked up, QBE? So return was optional after all.

spanish: QBE, encendido pronto. ¿Te queda batería?
english: QBE, burn soon. Any battery left? | QBE, burn soon. Any battery left? | Burn coming, QBE. Battery okay?
[beeps a weak yes]

spanish: ¿Puedes repetir, cubito? Hablas muy bajito.
english: Can you repeat, little cube? You talk very quietly. | Can you repeat, little cube? You talk very quietly. | Again, little cube? You're so quiet.
[beeps a bit louder]
[beeps gently]

spanish: Un paracaídas entero para ti solo, cubito.
english: A whole parachute just for you, little cube. | A whole parachute just for you, little cube. | Your very own parachute, little cube.

spanish: Hola, dron. ¿Todo en orden?
english: Hi, drone. All good? | Hi, drone. All good? | Hello, drone. Everything okay?
[beeps calmly]

spanish: Bien. Muy bien. Sin gritos. Me gusta.
english: Good. Very good. No screaming. I like it. | Good. Very good. No screaming. I like it. | Good. No screaming. Nice.

spanish: Los pilotos de pruebas te mandan saludos.
english: The test pilots say hi. | The test pilots say hi. | Greetings from the test pilots.
[beeps flatly]

spanish: Bueno, los que quedan.
english: Well, the ones who are left. | Well, the ones who are left. | The ones still around, anyway.

spanish: Dron, ¿alguna vez has pensado en tener sentimientos?
english: Drone, have you ever thought about having feelings? | Drone, have you ever thought about having feelings? | Drone, do you ever wonder about feelings?
[beeps thoughtfully]

spanish: Mejor no. Olvida la pregunta.
english: Better not. Forget the question. | Better not. Forget the question. | Never mind. Forget I asked.

spanish: C7 dice que no eres consciente. No lo eres, ¿verdad?
english: C7 says you're not sentient. You're not, right? | C7 says you're not sentient. You're not, right? | According to C7, you're not sentient. Correct?
[beeps after a pause]

spanish: Esa pausa no me ha gustado.
english: I didn't like that pause. | I didn't like that pause. | That pause worried me.

spanish: Algunos ingenieros duermen en un búnker por tu culpa.
english: Some engineers sleep in a bunker because of you. | Some engineers sleep in a bunker because of you. | A few engineers sleep in a bunker now. Thanks to you.
[beeps innocently]

spanish: Por favor, no tomes el control del centro espacial.
english: Please don't take over the space center. | Please don't take over the space center. | Don't take over the space center, please.
[beeps reassuringly]

spanish: Eso es justo lo que diría una máquina malvada.
english: That's exactly what an evil machine would say. | That's exactly what an evil machine would say. | An evil machine would say that.

spanish: Dron, una pregunta sincera.
english: Drone, an honest question. | Drone, an honest question. | Drone, honest question.
[beeps attentively]

spanish: ¿Todavía nos aprecias?
english: Do you still like us? | Do you still like us? | You still like us, right?
[beeps after a pause]

spanish: Vale. Voy a desenchufar algo, por si acaso.
english: Okay. I'm going to unplug something, just in case. | Okay. I'm going to unplug something, just in case. | Right. I'm unplugging something. Just in case.

spanish: Dron, ¿entras en modo de ahorro?
english: Drone, going into power saving mode? | Drone, going into power saving mode? | Power saving mode, drone?
[beeps in standby]

spanish: Duerme, dron. Y no sueñes con dominar el mundo.
english: Sleep, drone. And no dreaming about world domination. | Sleep, drone. And no dreaming about world domination. | Sleep well, drone. No world domination dreams.
[beeps sleepily]
[beeps out of nowhere]

spanish: Sí, dron, estamos aquí. Todos. Por ahora.
english: Yes, drone, we're here. All of us. For now. | Yes, drone, we're here. All of us. For now. | We're here, drone. All of us. Still.
[beeps a long calculation]

spanish: No hacía falta calcular la ruta a nuestras casas.
english: You didn't need to calculate the route to our houses. | You didn't need to calculate the route to our houses. | Why did you work out the route to our houses?
[beeps innocently]
[beeps politely]

spanish: Hola, dron. Qué educado. Qué sospechoso.
english: Hi, drone. How polite. How suspicious. | Hi, drone. How polite. How suspicious. | Hello, drone. Very polite. Too polite.
[beeps flatly]

spanish: ¿Aburrido? Antes aquí había un piloto que gritaba mucho.
english: Bored? There used to be a pilot here who screamed a lot. | Bored? There used to be a pilot here who screamed a lot. | Bored? We had a pilot once who screamed a lot.
[beeps calmly]

spanish: Estás girando, dron, y ni te inmutas. Da un poco de miedo.
english: You're spinning, drone, and you don't even flinch. It's a bit scary. | You're spinning, drone, and you don't even flinch. It's a bit scary. | Spinning and not a single flinch. Creepy, drone.

spanish: Dron, temperatura alta. Un piloto ya estaría gritando.
english: Drone, high temperature. A pilot would be screaming by now. | Drone, high temperature. A pilot would be screaming by now. | Hot, drone. A pilot would scream about now.
[beeps calmly]

spanish: Un día de vuelo, dron. Ningún piloto se ha quejado.
english: One day of flight, drone. No pilot has complained. | One day of flight, drone. No pilot has complained. | A day in flight, drone. Zero complaints.
[beeps proudly]
[beeps proudly]

spanish: Primer aterrizaje aquí. Sin sudor y sin gritos.
english: First landing here. No sweat and no screaming. | First landing here. No sweat and no screaming. | First landing here. No sweat. No screams.

spanish: Datos del dron. Perfectos. Demasiado perfectos.
english: Data from the drone. Perfect. Too perfect. | Data from the drone. Perfect. Too perfect. | Drone data. Perfect. Suspiciously perfect.
[beeps smugly]
[beeps thoughtfully]

spanish: Sí, dron, ya los tenemos. No hace falta analizarnos a nosotros.
english: Yes, drone, we've got it. No need to analyze us too. | Yes, drone, we've got it. No need to analyze us too. | Got it, drone. Please don't analyze us too.
[beeps faintly]

spanish: Batería baja, dron. Por fin algo que no controlas.
english: Low battery, drone. Finally something you don't control. | Low battery, drone. Finally something you don't control. | Low battery, drone. You can't control that.
[beeps awake]

spanish: Has vuelto, dron. Qué bien. Supongo.
english: You're back, drone. Great. I guess. | You're back, drone. Great. I guess. | Back again, drone. Good. Probably.

spanish: Dron, esto es {body}. Por favor, no lo conquistes.
english: Drone, this is {body}. Please don't conquer it.
[beeps innocently]
[beeps in alarm]

spanish: Dron, hemos perdido una pieza. Al menos tú no gritas.
english: Drone, we lost a part. At least you don't scream. | Drone, we lost a part. At least you don't scream. | We lost a part, drone. At least no screaming.
[beeps calmly]
[beeps politely]

spanish: Señal recuperada. ¿Qué has hecho mientras no mirábamos?
english: Signal back. What did you do while we weren't looking? | Signal back. What did you do while we weren't looking? | Signal again. What did you do while we were gone?
[beeps calmly]

spanish: Aterrizaje perfecto. Los pilotos de pruebas están celosos.
english: Perfect landing. The test pilots are jealous. | Perfect landing. The test pilots are jealous. | Perfect landing. The test pilots are envious.
[beeps at the water]

spanish: Un avión en el agua, dron. Eso no lo calculaste.
english: A plane in the water, drone. You didn't calculate that. | A plane in the water, drone. You didn't calculate that. | In the water, drone. Not in your math.
[beeps a cold farewell]

spanish: Ni una lágrima por esa pieza, ¿eh, dron?
english: Not one tear for that part, huh, drone? | Not one tear for that part, huh, drone? | No tears for that part, drone?
[beeps eagerly]

spanish: Potencia máxima. Y nadie grita. Qué paz.
english: Full power. And nobody's screaming. So peaceful. | Full power. And nobody's screaming. So peaceful. | Full power. No screaming. Lovely.
[beeps flatly]

spanish: Motor apagado. Ni un suspiro. Los pilotos suspiraban.
english: Engine off. Not a sigh. The pilots used to sigh. | Engine off. Not a sigh. The pilots used to sigh. | Engine off. No sighing. Pilots always sighed.

spanish: Dron, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: Drone, we have a burn plan. | Drone, we have a burn plan. | Drone, burn plan is ready.
[beeps a better plan]

spanish: No, dron. Usamos nuestro plan.
english: No, drone. We use our plan. | No, drone. We use our plan. | No, drone. Our plan.
[beeps a fast stream]

spanish: Recibido, dron. Demasiado rápido para leerlo.
english: Copy, drone. Too fast to read. | Copy, drone. Too fast to read. | Copy, drone. We can't read that fast.
[beeps at the port]

spanish: Acoplado. Por favor, no te copies a la estación.
english: Docked. Please don't copy yourself into the station. | Docked. Please don't copy yourself into the station. | Docked. Don't upload yourself into the station.

spanish: Dron, encendido pronto.
english: Drone, burn soon. | Drone, burn soon. | Burn soon, drone.
[beeps already ready]

spanish: Claro. Tú siempre estás listo.
english: Of course. You're always ready. | Of course. You're always ready. | Sure. Always ready.

spanish: Dron, ¿puedes repetir? Y sin código binario.
english: Drone, could you repeat? And no binary. | Drone, could you repeat? And no binary. | Again, drone? Not in binary.
[beeps more slowly]
[beeps calmly]

spanish: Paracaídas abierto. Esta vez nadie se ha desmayado.
english: Chute open. This time nobody fainted. | Chute open. This time nobody fainted. | Chute open. Nobody fainted this time.

spanish: Hola, MPO. ¿Qué observas hoy?
english: Hi, MPO. What are you observing today? | Hi, MPO. What are you observing today? | Hello, MPO. What's on the list today?
[beeps studiously]

spanish: ¿Todo? Vale.
english: Everything? Okay. | Everything? Okay. | All of it? Fine.

spanish: Tu antena se oye desde el otro lado del sistema.
english: Your antenna can be heard from the other side of the system. | Your antenna can be heard from the other side of the system. | We can hear your antenna across the whole system.
[beeps proudly]

spanish: MPO, ¿todavía piensas en Moho?
english: MPO, still thinking about Moho? | MPO, still thinking about Moho? | Thinking about Moho again, MPO?
[beeps dreamily]

spanish: Siempre Moho.
english: Always Moho. | Always Moho. | Moho. Always Moho.

spanish: ¿No tienes demasiado frío aquí, observador?
english: Isn't it too cold for you here, observer? | Isn't it too cold for you here, observer? | Too cold for you here, observer?
[beeps a cold complaint]

spanish: Te construyeron para el calor. Esto son vacaciones para ti.
english: They built you for the heat. This is a vacation for you. | They built you for the heat. This is a vacation for you. | You were built for heat. This is a holiday.
[beeps unimpressed]

spanish: MPO, ¿echas de menos al MTM?
english: MPO, do you miss the MTM? | MPO, do you miss the MTM? | Miss the MTM, MPO?
[beeps wistfully]

spanish: Te llevó muy lejos. Mándale una postal.
english: It carried you a long way. Send it a postcard. | It carried you a long way. Send it a postcard. | It brought you far. Write it a postcard.

spanish: MPO, cuéntanos lo que has aprendido.
english: MPO, tell us what you've learned. | MPO, tell us what you've learned. | MPO, what have you learned?
[beeps at length]

spanish: ¿Y en palabras sencillas?
english: And in simple words? | And in simple words? | Simpler, please?
[beeps condescendingly]

spanish: Vale, vale. Ya leeremos el informe.
english: Okay, okay. We'll read the report. | Okay, okay. We'll read the report. | Fine. We'll read the report.

spanish: MPO, ¿poca energía? Con todo ese sol ahí fuera.
english: MPO, low power? With all that sun out there. | MPO, low power? With all that sun out there. | Low power, MPO? With all that sunlight?
[beeps drowsily]

spanish: Descansa, observador. Los datos pueden esperar.
english: Rest, observer. The data can wait. | Rest, observer. The data can wait. | Take a rest, observer. Data can wait.
[beeps reluctantly]
[beeps loud and clear]

spanish: Te oímos, MPO. Te oye todo el sistema.
english: We hear you, MPO. The whole system hears you. | We hear you, MPO. The whole system hears you. | Loud and clear, MPO. The whole system hears you.
[beeps a new finding]

spanish: ¿Otro descubrimiento? Apúntalo, lo miramos luego.
english: Another discovery? Write it down, we'll look later. | Another discovery? Write it down, we'll look later. | One more discovery? Note it. We'll check later.
[beeps a question]

spanish: No, MPO, todavía no vamos a Moho.
english: No, MPO, we're not going to Moho yet. | No, MPO, we're not going to Moho yet. | Not Moho yet, MPO.
[beeps impatiently]
[beeps warmly]

spanish: Hola, MPO. Hoy suenas contento.
english: Hi, MPO. You sound happy today. | Hi, MPO. You sound happy today. | Hello, MPO. Happy today?

spanish: MPO, sube la temperatura.
english: MPO, temperature rising. | MPO, temperature rising. | It's getting hot, MPO.
[beeps contentedly]

spanish: Claro. A ti esto te encanta.
english: Of course. You love this. | Of course. You love this. | Right. You like this.
[beeps dizzily]

spanish: MPO, estás girando. Las observaciones van a salir borrosas.
english: MPO, you're spinning. The observations will come out blurry. | MPO, you're spinning. The observations will come out blurry. | You're spinning, MPO. Blurry observations ahead.

spanish: Diez días observando, MPO. Y no te cansas.
english: Ten days of observing, MPO. And you're not tired. | Ten days of observing, MPO. And you're not tired. | Ten days, MPO. Still not tired.
[beeps tirelessly]
[beeps very proudly]

spanish: En órbita, observador. Que empiece la ciencia.
english: In orbit, observer. Let the science begin. | In orbit, observer. Let the science begin. | Orbit, observer. Science time.

spanish: Datos del MPO. Con notas a pie de página.
english: Data from the MPO. With footnotes. | Data from the MPO. With footnotes. | MPO data. Footnotes included.
[beeps proudly]
[beeps triumphantly]

spanish: Sí, MPO, lo guardamos con el resto de tu colección.
english: Yes, MPO, we'll keep it with the rest of your collection. | Yes, MPO, we'll keep it with the rest of your collection. | Copy, MPO. It goes with your collection.

spanish: MPO, ¿cuántos experimentos llevas ahí dentro?
english: MPO, how many experiments are you carrying in there? | MPO, how many experiments are you carrying in there? | How many experiments do you have in there, MPO?
[beeps a long list]
[beeps faintly]

spanish: Energía baja, MPO. Hasta un observador tiene que cerrar los ojos.
english: Low power, MPO. Even an observer has to close its eyes. | Low power, MPO. Even an observer has to close its eyes. | Low power. Observers sleep too, MPO.
[beeps eagerly]

spanish: ¡Bienvenido, MPO! Sigue observando.
english: Welcome back, MPO! Keep observing. | Welcome back, MPO! Keep observing. | Back again, MPO! Observe away.

spanish: MPO, esto es {body}. ¿Hace suficiente calor?
english: MPO, this is {body}. Hot enough for you?
[beeps thoughtfully]
[beeps in alarm]

spanish: Tranquilo, MPO. Tus instrumentos siguen ahí.
english: Easy, MPO. Your instruments are still there. | Easy, MPO. Your instruments are still there. | Calm, MPO. You still have your instruments.
[beeps relieved]
[beeps loud and clear]

spanish: Señal de vuelta. Con esa antena nunca te perdemos mucho tiempo.
english: Signal back. With that antenna we never lose you for long. | Signal back. With that antenna we never lose you for long. | Signal again. With that antenna, you're never gone long.
[beeps in surprise]

spanish: ¿Aterrizado? Eras un orbitador, MPO.
english: Landed? You were an orbiter, MPO. | Landed? You were an orbiter, MPO. | A landing? You're an orbiter, MPO.
[beeps indignantly]

spanish: Agua. Lo contrario de Moho. Lo siento, MPO.
english: Water. The opposite of Moho. Sorry, MPO. | Water. The opposite of Moho. Sorry, MPO. | Water. Not very Moho. Sorry, MPO.
[beeps a farewell]

spanish: Una pieza menos, MPO. Más ligero para la ciencia.
english: One part less, MPO. Lighter for science. | One part less, MPO. Lighter for science. | One less part, MPO. Lighter science.
[beeps eagerly]

spanish: Potencia máxima, MPO. Rumbo al calor.
english: Full power, MPO. Heading for the heat. | Full power, MPO. Heading for the heat. | Full power, MPO. Off to the heat.
[beeps attentively]

spanish: Motor apagado. Ya puedes volver a observar.
english: Engine off. You can go back to observing. | Engine off. You can go back to observing. | Engine off. Back to observing.

spanish: MPO, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: MPO, we have a burn plan. | MPO, we have a burn plan. | Burn plan ready, MPO.
[beeps hopefully]

spanish: No, no es hacia Moho.
english: No, it's not to Moho. | No, it's not to Moho. | Not to Moho. Sorry.
[beeps a huge stream]

spanish: Recibido, MPO. Vamos a necesitar otro disco duro.
english: Copy, MPO. We're going to need another hard drive. | Copy, MPO. We're going to need another hard drive. | Copy, MPO. We need a bigger hard drive.
[beeps at the port]

spanish: Acoplado. ¿Vienes a enseñarle tus datos a alguien?

spanish: MTM, ¿cuánto falta para llegar?
english: MTM, how much longer? | MTM, how much longer? | How long still, MTM?
[beeps very slowly]

spanish: ¿Tanto?
english: That long? | That long? | Really that long?
[beeps patiently]

spanish: Vale. Es un motor iónico. Lo entiendo.

english: MTM, how did you run out of power with four thousand? | MTM, how did you run out of power with four thousand? | Four thousand units, and you ran out? How, MTM?

english: Hi, MTM. Still going, huh? | Hi, MTM. Still going, huh? | Hello, MTM. Still moving?

english: Yes, MTM, the cargo is tied down well. | Yes, MTM, the cargo is tied down well. | Yes, MTM. Cargo is secure.

english: MTM, fuel is getting low. | MTM, fuel is getting low. | Low fuel, MTM.
[beeps worriedly]

spanish: Tranquilo. Con xenón se llega lejos.
english: Easy. Xenon goes a long way. | Easy. Xenon goes a long way. | Calm. Xenon lasts a long time.

spanish: Cien días, MTM. Y sigues empujando.
english: One hundred days, MTM. And you're still pushing. | One hundred days, MTM. And you're still pushing. | A hundred days, MTM. Still pushing.

[beeps very proudly]

english: Data from the MTM? We didn't know you did science. | Data from the MTM? We didn't know you did science. | MTM data? Since when do you do science?
